profile.headline: Jr Software Developer at Best Value Technology Incorporated
profile.summary: As a computer scientist I have developed a deep understanding of programming and information technology. My studies have formed me into a keen technician and software developer with experience of online security packages and tools. Being a computer scientist and lifelong pursuer of knowledge with a strong foundation, I constantly strive to add new skills to my repertoire.  I love studying all aspects of coding and security from technologies and software to varied attacks and malware to enhance my analytical ability needed to resolve issues and identify security vulnerabilities and risks. I have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, which allow me to quickly establish good working relationships, to learn quickly and to communicate pressing information and reports as needed.

positions.title: Jr Software Developer
positions.description: I am a junior software developer working as a full stack django dev.

positions.title: Assistant Groomer
positions.description: Provided wellness to dogs through grooming processes and guaranteed comfort during pre- and post-groom sessions, leading to leading to more easily manageable pets. Maintained supplies and provided customer care, increasing customer throughput.

positions.title: Store Manager
positions.description: Managed store’s vendor activities and deliveries, increasing reliable inventorying. Led sales efforts and product demonstrations to streamline the sales process during busy retail hours, improving customer relations and satisfaction. Provided analytical, technical and operational support for pool management during peak pool season weeks.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Software design and support of internal web sites. Streamlined daily report creation for manager leading to reduced effort and time spent on supervisory tasks. Designed and tested online landing and product help web pages to improve aesthetic.

positions.title: Retail Associate
positions.description: I worked at GameStop for the duration of the summer between my senior year of high school and my freshman year at Longwood University. I handled the register, worked as a greeter, organized products in the store, and provided advice and knowledge to customers seeking help.

positions.title: Assistant Coach
positions.description: While working for the Daryll Gee Academy I assisted in coaching U12 through U16 soccer groups and coached U8 groups. As a coach, I created exercises to keep the children entertained while also giving them a good workout to help improve their technical skills. As an assistant coach, I helped run exercises more smoothly and interacted with parents to make sure everyone involved had an enjoyable experience at our summer camp.
